annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it presents OneCoin as a promotional opportunity and asks participants to buy and sell assets through token trading on an exchange. It links that participation and money flow to the claim that investing there will produce “a lot of profit,” although no completed transaction or realized return is shown.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S05 is supported because the material describes Bitcoin investment, token trading, and buying and selling shares in connection with profit. The evidence supports a token or crypto investment-return relationship, but does not establish a completed purchase or realized appreciation.
